title: Game runtime generation
description: B1: the effective configuration the control plane hands one game runtime, as generation.json in that runtime's own directory of the generations volume, beside the secrets.json of the same generation. The runtime validates both, refuses a contract version it does not know, and keeps running its last good generation. Any change to this document other than its generation number, disconnect_players, backups and updates, or to its secrets, costs the world a game-server restart; a newer generation that differs in nothing else is adopted without one, its backups and updates with it. The runtime makes that restart only once it counts no players, unless disconnect_players says the server manager confirmed it.

generation.description: The generation number. A higher number replaces a lower one.

port.description: The first of the world's three UDP ports.

status_interval_s.description: How often the plugin rewrites the runtime's world status file, and the runtime reports its status, in seconds.

intake_url.description: Where the plugin posts telemetry batches (B2): intake's POST /events on the install network.

backups.description: How the runtime backs up its world. Adopted in place: a change costs no restart.

every_s.description: How often, at most, the runtime backs up a new save, in seconds.

keep.description: How many of its newest backups the runtime keeps, besides its daily ones.

keep_daily.description: How many daily backups the runtime keeps, one a day.

updates.description: The update policy. Adopted in place: a change costs no restart.

policy.description: when-empty or at-start, as the manifest's updates.policy says.

every_s.description: How often the runtime checks Steam for a newer game build, in seconds.

disconnect_players.description: Whether the server manager confirmed restarting this world with players online, for this generation alone (vhd apply --disconnect-players). Absent or false, a runtime waits until it counts no players before restarting the game for this generation.

status_url.description: Where the runtime reports its status to the control plane. Absent, the runtime only logs it.
